* Example 3:
[Input]
```INPUT_TEXT
Slide Title: Google & GCP: Key Year-Based Developments
Slide Content: 
-1998: Search Engine Launch - Foundation: Google's search engine began, revolutionizing information access with its PageRank algorithm, setting the stage for future innovations.
-2004: Gmail - Communication: Gmail launched, offering vast storage and a new approach to email management, significantly impacting online communication standards.
-2008: Chrome & App Engine - Web & Cloud: Chrome browser debuted, challenging existing browsers; App Engine introduced PaaS, marking Google's entry into cloud computing.
-2012: Compute Engine - Infrastructure: Compute Engine provided IaaS, enabling scalable virtual machines, a major step in building Cloud Platform's core services.
-2014: Kubernetes - Containerization: Kubernetes was open-sourced, automating container deployment and management, becoming a leading orchestration platform.
-2019: Anthos - Hybrid Cloud: Anthos launched, allowing consistent management of applications across on-premises and cloud environments, addressing hybrid needs.
-2023: Generative AI - Innovation: Google introduced advanced generative AI models, like PaLM 2 and Gemini, demonstrating significant strides in AI capabilities.
```
